newsitems.title: Demo 0.4.0 - Patch Notes
newsitems.author: bitrotgamesstudio
newsitems.contents:
[h1]Demo 0.4.0[/h1]

[h2]Highlights[/h2]
[list]
[*]Lieutenants
[*]Queued orders, deployment presets, curved charges and knockdowns
[*]New UI, lord portraits and a redrawn campaign map
[*]Rebuilt sieges: a real map for every town based on the overworld location, choose your attack side, new attack and defence AI, breakable walls, siege engines
[*]Hostile actions: burn farms and granaries, poison wells, rob treasuries, sabotage workshops
[*]Town events, news, strangers on the road and new jobs
[/list]

[h2]New[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added Lieutenants. Promote veterans into named lieutenants with one of 37 traits, unlocked in the new Lieutenants skill branch
[*]Every lord in a battle now fights as a lieutenant under his own flag
[*]Added queued orders (hold Shift)
[*]Added deployment presets for field battles
[*]Added curved charges: in charge mode, drag through a point to bend the charge
[*]Added knockdowns: cavalry charges knock foot soldiers down for 1-2 seconds
[*]Added a siege map for every walled town, built from its real rivers, coast, roads and size
[*]Added a choice of which side to attack a town from
[*]Added breakable stone walls. Catapults knock out blocks, and 5 hits bring a section down
[*]Siege engines are now inventory items that keep their damage between battles
[*]Added siege workshops in Chalcombe, Rushmoor and Mabington. They make catapults (2,250 silver) and mantlets (450), and repair engines
[*]Added the mantlet: a wheeled screen up to 3 archers can shoot from behind
[*]Enemy engines can be captured after a battle. Lose a battle and they take yours
[*]Lord armies of 150+ men can bring siege engines
[*]Added sergeant tips for ladders and siege engines in your first siege
[*]Added a warning when you assault walls with no ladders
[*]Right-click a wall with ladder bearers selected to plant ladders and climb. Other foot soldiers in the selection follow them up
[*]Added a new war system. Kingdoms claim one town at a time, and war starts 10 days later unless the owner gives it up
[*]When a kingdom claims your town you can hand it over, pay tribute or fight
[*]Wars end when the town has been held for 15 days, a side runs out of men or money, or after 120 days. A 120-day truce follows
[*]Added war cards for wars between other kingdoms, and a card when a war ends
[*]A kingdom that loses its last town falls, and its lords go into exile
[*]Added standing with each kingdom, from -100 to +100 (Hostile to Trusted), shown on the Factions tab with what changed it
[*]A kingdom that turns Hostile while you hold no town sends lords to hunt you
[*]Added mercenary contracts: 60 days, a daily retainer, bounties and jobs paying 250-2,000 silver
[*]Added sworn vassalage. Serve a king, receive a fief, answer his calls to arms
[*]Added buying lords from the encounter screen. AI lords who hate their king can defect
[*]Added non-aggression pacts and alliances by letter
[*]Added orders for your own lords (Join me, Defend, Attack, Raid, Hunt bandits, Go home)
[*]Added player-formed armies from your own lords
[*]Nearby allied armies now join your field battles
[*]Added kings' treasuries and taxes. Broke kings lose their armies and stop making claims
[*]Added tariffs, embargoes and trade pacts between kingdoms, including on you
[*]Added Hostile actions: Lay siege, Burn the farms, Burn the granary, Poison the wells, Rob the treasury, Sabotage an industry
[*]Covert actions use 10 men, show your odds first, and raise the town's watch
[*]Added town events (14 kinds, such as fire, plague, blight, rich vein and festival) that change stocks, output and prices
[*]Added News to the Rumours tab: events, raids, sieges, captures and your own deeds
[*]Added "Where can I find…" to the Rumours tab
[*]Added strangers on the road who ask for food, silver, a horse or a ride
[*]Added the Poachers and Road patrol jobs
[*]Added a portrait for every lord, and faces for bandit chiefs, merchants and the sergeant
[*]Added a Man/Woman choice for your character
[*]Herbs now heal a wounded man instantly (Heal and Heal all on the Army screen)
[*]Town labels show how many lords are inside, and tooltips show each lord's current job
[*]Holding 3 settlements now shows a thank-you screen, with Keep Playing
[*]Added Goals: after Feed the Warband, pick 1 of 3 goals for XP, silver, cohesion and a small permanent bonus
[*]Added a short walkthrough of the town screen on your first visit
[/list]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]New UI look across every screen
[*]Redrew settlements on the campaign map: houses, walls, workshops, fields, pastures, mines and wharves
[*]Redrew forests, mountains, the sea, bridges and bandit camps on the campaign map
[*]Redrew human crossbowmen, swordsmen and spearmen
[*]Redrew goblins and renamed them (Goblin Spearman, Goblin Swordsman, Goblin Wolf Archer, Goblin Wolf Rider, Goblin Shaman)
[*]Reworked cavalry charges: damage, knockback and knockdown grow with the run-up
[*]Reworked the enemy AI's flank attacks, cavalry charges and opening plans
[*]Melee troops now attack an enemy already in reach instead of walking past him
[*]Rebuilt the AI for attacking and defending sieges
[*]Sieges now have a 500-man limit per side. The rest arrive in waves
[*]All lords in a besieging army attack, and all lords inside a town defend
[*]When defending a siege you can deploy anywhere inside your town
[*]Garrisons no longer refill during a siege
[*]Garrison limit is set by size: hamlet 25, village 75, town 150, city 300, plus 40 for barracks
[*]A garrison over its limit loses its lowest-tier troops first
[*]Your siege engines start without crew, in custom battles too
[*]Lords have one job at a time, shown in tooltips (Besieging, Raiding, Defending, Patrolling…)
[*]Lords defending a town now stay inside it
[*]Lords only attack a town when they have enough men to take it. If not, they raid
[*]Raiding lords now burn farms, burn granaries and poison wells
[*]Captured lords are released when wars end and can escape
[*]Lord armies buy food from towns
[*]Dunmere and Solmark now share a border. Deerford and Mabington belong to Solmark
[*]Jobs on a town board now come from its lord. They are removed when the town changes hands
[*]Recruiting no longer lowers a town's population
[*]Towns now grow back after losses and shrink when short of food
[*]Big towns send more caravans
[*]Wounds now heal in 8 days for every troop. Resting in a town doubles the speed
[*]Field Surgeon now has 2 ranks: I halves deaths, II doubles healing speed
[*]Your army no longer stops to loot after a battle
[*]Camp and road events happen every 10-20 days
[*]Event popups show the faces of the soldiers involved
[*]Choosing deserters to recruit now uses a picker
[*]Auto-resolve is available against bands from jobs you haven't taken
[*]If a party you are following enters a settlement, you now stop and the game pauses
[*]Bandits are named by race (Human bandits, Goblin bandits). Camps are named by size and place
[*]Map labels have a thicker faction outline, and enemies at war with you show a crossed-swords icon
[*]A battle between two AI armies on the map now shows as one label
[*]Settlement header shows the owner, their flag and the town's speciality
[*]Settlement panels are now the same width for every town
[*]Battle maps show terrain beyond the edge
[*]Dead bodies darken quickly. Blood and dust redrawn
[*]Reworked the custom battle screen
[*]Reworked the Load screen
[*]Quests are now called Jobs, and Realm is now Faction
[*]English text shortened and changed to UK spelling
[/list]

[h2]Balance[/h2]
[list]
[*]Human troop wages reduced by 25% (0.75 / 1.5 / 2.25 / 4.5 / 7.5 a day by tier)
[*]Goblin troop wages halved
[*]1 food now feeds 15 men a day (was 10)
[*]Auto-resolve now available at 2-to-1 odds (was 3-to-1)
[*]Nearby armies join a battle from 100 away (was 320)
[*]Lord renown fades by 5% a month
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed garrisons gaining or losing men after battles
[*]Fixed a taken town's garrison limit changing when you take another town
[*]Fixed wounded men sent to a garrison coming back healed
[*]Fixed Save and Exit saving an old copy of the world
[*]Fixed AI sieges stopping after loading a save
[*]Fixed a lord continuing a siege after the town changed owner
[*]Fixed lords keeping a ruined town, and caravans trading with ruins
[*]Fixed bandit camps appearing on islands
[*]Fixed quest map markers showing on every band of the same type
[*]Fixed horsemen and siege engine crews being given ladders
[*]Fixed troops crowding at the foot of a ladder
[*]Fixed troops getting stuck on stairs
[*]Fixed climbers leaving a ladder when the men who placed it died
[*]Fixed Mounted Archers drawn without bows
[*]Fixed newly arrived troops taking orders from dead units
[*]Fixed memory increasing with every load, which could crash the game
[*]Fixed the Sally popup not pausing the game
[*]Fixed some market prices rounding up by 1 silver
[*]Fixed the Prisoners badge staying on after ransoming everyone
[*]Fixed dawn stutters on the campaign map
[*]Fixed stutters in large battles
[/list]

[h2]Notes for old saves[/h2]
[list]
[*]Saves from 0.3.x cannot be loaded. Please start a new campaign.
[/list]

newsitems.title: Demo 0.3.9 - Patch Notes
newsitems.author: bitrotgamesstudio
newsitems.contents:
[h1]Demo 0.3.9[/h1]

[h2]New[/h2]
[list]
[*]Rebuilt looting and inventory as one two-panel screen: category filter, sort by name, slider or Shift/Ctrl to move stacks, "Take all", and item tooltips. Added a Drop action to the Inventory tab.
[*]Added the ability to take a cart or wagon straight from the loot screen, with its carrying capacity applied immediately.
[*]Added a category filter to market screens and made columns sortable (name, price, and demand in towns).
[*]Added tooltips to carts, wagons, horses and livestock.
[*]Reworked the party-speed readout to list every factor affecting your pace. Spare pack horses now speed the army up; large surplus herds slow it down.
[*]Added road travel bonuses and clearer distances: march time in the details panel, distance-in-days on settlement and army hovers, and a fastest-route option on Shift (rebindable).
[*]Added faction colours and hover info to caravans.
[*]Added Auto-resolve for field battles you badly outmatch. Settles the fight instantly with light losses and the full aftermath (results, prisoners, loot, silver, XP). Offered at 3-to-1 odds or better, versus a single enemy force, with no allied lords present.
[/list]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Bandit camp spoils now go through the loot screen with carry limits.
[*]Reduced the carts and wagons settlements stockpile, and aligned workshop cart/wagon recipe costs with town production.
[*]Added a crossbow reload animation between shots.
[*]Ranged units can no longer fire while being attacked in melee (each melee hit resets their shot).
[*]Loot rows now stay visible at zero once taken, keeping their slider, and the slider now fills as goods move into your pack (matching the marketplace).
[*]Town market columns (town stock and your inventory) now scroll independently.
[*]Outnumbered enemies that can't form a proper shield wall now attack instead of standing still, committing forward or hooking a flank toward your archers rather than waiting to be ground down; outnumbered archers kite and shoot instead of holding. Forces that can actually make a stand still hold.
[/list]

[h2]Balance[/h2]
[list]
[*]Reduced crossbow rate of fire to one bolt every 2.7s (was 1.8s).
[*]Reduced shield-wall damage reduction: ranged 80% to 60%, melee 60% to 40%.
[*]Added armour piercing to knight lances (still glances off skeletons).
[*]Increased prisoner ransoms. Commoners now ransom for 60% of their recruit cost; junior lord base 300 to 1,000, lord base 1,200 to 2,000 (before wealth and Ransom Broker).
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed armies pathing across lakes and open water; they now route around water or stop at the shore.
[*]Fixed a city's Economy tab showing every building producing Grain after loading a save.
[*]Fixed turning off Tactical Pause mid-battle leaving the fight frozen.
[*]Fixed leaving a paused battle leaving health bars and range rings stuck on afterward.
[*]Fixed an abandoned quest from a previous game progressing invisibly in a new one; new games now start with a clean quest slate.
[*]Fixed "Take all" stuttering on very large loot piles.
[*]Fixed the map scrolling behind the loot screen while sacking a town.
[*]Fixed a slain vassal still holding its settlement and blocking a replacement; the seat now frees up and stops counting against your vassal limit.
[*]Fixed AI-vs-AI battles progressing while the game was paused (time pause or pause menu).
[*]Fixed towns and lords offering no quests after loading a save (the day counter reset to zero on load, leaving every quest on cooldown).
[*]Fixed a robbed caravan sometimes remaining on the map with its goods after you won the fight.
[/list]

[h2]Notes for old saves[/h2]
[list]
[*]Saves from 0.3.8 load and carry on. Visited towns keep their current stockpiles; the new cart/wagon limits apply as their economies settle.
[/list]

newsitems.title: Demo 0.3.8 - Patch Notes
newsitems.author: bitrotgamesstudio
newsitems.contents:
[h1]Demo 0.3.8[/h1]

[h2]Battles[/h2]
[list]
[*]New: optional tactical pause. Turn it on in Settings, then press Space in a battle to freeze the fight and give your orders at your own pace. Movement arrows and destination markers show while paused, and your orders carry out the moment you unpause. It can be rebound to another key, and it is off by default. Indicators for charges still need to be added.
[*]Custom battles now let you build your own army unit by unit, instead of only using the ready-made presets.
[/list]

[h2]Interface[/h2]
[list]
[*]The custom battle setup screen is taller, so you can see more of your army while you build it.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed longbowmen behaving like melee infantry: they now loose arrows again, hold their ground at range instead of creeping toward the enemy, and show their range ring.
[*]Fixed large armies deploying outside their start zone, sometimes off the edge of the map.
[*]Fixed ranged units behind the front line bunching into a single column instead of spreading across the line.
[*]Fixed the size buttons in the banner designer shifting around as you changed the banner's dimensions; the banner now grows and shrinks from the centre of a fixed frame.
[*]Fixed rivers, especially narrow tributaries, sometimes generating thin enough to walk across; watercourses now always form a solid barrier so units and enemy armies can only cross at a ford.
[*]Fixed the equipment counts on unit-upgrade buttons showing a wrong number after an upgrade; they now always show how much you actually hold.
[*]Fixed looted gear sometimes splitting into two separate stacks of the same item; stacks now always merge into one.
[*]Fixed saving partway through the opening sequence corrupting it on reload (the scene teleporting to the map corner, or being able to wander off before the rescue). Saving is now disabled until the opening is over.
[*]Roughly halved the graphics memory battles use for corpses, which was pushing some integrated and older graphics cards over their limit and crashing them.
[/list]

[h2]Notes for old saves[/h2]
[list]
[*]Saves from 0.3.7 load and carry on.
[*]If an item was split into two stacks in an older save, the two stacks merge back into one when you load.
[/list]

newsitems.title: Demo 0.3.7 - Patch Notes
newsitems.author: bitrotgamesstudio
newsitems.contents:
[h1]Demo 0.3.7[/h1]

[h2]Battles[/h2]
[list]
[*]Shield wall placement previews now update live to show where your men will actually stand.
[*]Enemy armies now try to march around large rocks and rivers rather than straight into them.
[*]Enemy armies now cross fords to reach you instead of stalling at the water's edge.
[/list]

[h2]Interface[/h2]
[list]
[*]Market and inventory items now show a tooltip — what they're worth, how they're made, and which unit upgrades use them.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where robbing caravans did not count towards the caravan robbing quest.
[*]Fixed an issue where some units would ignore a new order given while they were still moving.
[*]Fixed an issue where units forming up beside water or rock could be placed hard against the edge.
[*]Fixed lords briefly flickering onto the map while stationed in a settlement.
[*]Fixed camps and parties hidden in the fog of war still showing a tooltip on hover.
[*]Fixed the volley fire range ring showing a shorter reach than the ability could actually fire.
[*]Fixed winning a battle against an attacking army while besieging a settlement wrongly lifting the siege; it now continues (losing still lifts it).
[*]Fixed crows on the ground sometimes being invisible until they took flight.
[*]Fixed right-clicking an enemy switching your units to aggressive stance; they now keep whatever stance they were in.
[*]Fixed the Gameplay options running off the edge of the settings panel.
[*]Fixed ordering a shield wall to move sometimes marching it backwards, away from where you clicked.
[/list]

[h2]Notes for old saves[/h2]
[list]
[*]Saves from 0.3.6 load and carry on.
[/list]

newsitems.title: Demo 0.3.6 - Patch Notes
newsitems.author: bitrotgamesstudio
newsitems.contents:
[h1]Demo 0.3.6[/h1]

[h2]Battles[/h2]
[list]
[*]Hover one of your soldiers in a battle to see their name and portrait on the info card.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a black screen on startup that stopped some players reaching the main menu.
[*]Likely (still unconfirmed) fix for a bug where every town but the capital could vanish from the map after the opening battle, with all armies then spawning from that one city. If it still happens, sending us a save would help us pin it down.
[*]Fixed a rare error when choosing Flee, Attack or Bribe on an enemy army destroyed at that same moment.
[*]Cleaned up the parallax backgrounds in the main menu slightly.
[/list]
